title: Bright Cleveland Park Guest House! 2 Bed 2 Bath
description:
Welcome to your home away from home in East Nashville! This beautifully designed 700 sqft guest house offers a great blend of modern comfort and charm. Both bedrooms have their own en suite bathrooms - perfect to get ready before hitting the town or exploring Middle Tennessee.

The location is convenient with many coffee shops and restaurants in the neighborhood. 5 min drive to Five Points in East Nashville, 5-10 min to Lower Broadway, 15 min to 12 South, and 15 min to the airport.

The space
The primary bedroom features a luxurious king bed,  while the second bedroom has a cozy queen bed. Both bedrooms have comfortable linens and a sleek wall-mounted smart TV.

The bathrooms include modern fixtures, glass door showers, and complimentary toiletries.

The living area and kitchen have great natural light and a comfortable feel. There is a smart TV in the living area and the kitchen is fully equipped with stainless steel appliances and complimentary coffee.

Also included are high speed Wi-Fi, central heating and cooling, and a washer and dryer.

Guest access
The entire second floor of the building is yours with a private exterior staircase.

Other things to note
Please note the following governmental taxes, which are different from Airbnb fees. Airbnb initially displays prices with fees included, but taxes will not be displayed until you proceed to book a reservation.

As of January 2026:
Tennessee Sales Tax: 7%
Nashville Sales Tax: 2.25%
Nashville Hotel Occupancy Tax: 6% plus $2.50 per night
